selection_scope.limitation: The source and marker establish the archived pipeline ordering; hashes/timestamps are not independent preregistration or evidence that authors had never inspected these historical targets.

tie_policies.scope: All 1,074 positive-width cases, both secondary policies and every saved positive support. Secondary LPs independently solved using product-vertex constraints and HiGHS IPM; no import of audit_ties, no forecast fit, no original full-study rerun. Frozen zero-width cases and all case/meter/cohort aggregates reconciled. Ordinary floating-point tolerances, not outward-rounded formal certificates.

randomized_holdout.check_kind: Independent arithmetic and saved-dual verification; no recovery implementation or optimizer imported

scaling.check_kind: independent archival consistency and checksum checks; no optimization rerun

review_revision_reproduction.scope: Default verifies distributed period traces/interval aggregates, all randomized public cases, compact policy compilation, NOAA decoded excerpts, independent tie/holdout-policy replay and archived scaling consistency, then rebuilds TeX. Extension checks use separate copies preserving archived reports. It is not fresh NOAA GRIB/raw-source decoding or fresh scaling measurement. --rerun-scaling additionally repeats the frozen scaling measurements in isolation. --raw additionally restores original energy targets without refitting and runs both corrected energy analyses. --reconstruct-only stops after exact raw-input reconstruction. No PDF compilation or journal submission.

numerical_sample_design.meters: Household and lexically first/last original Portugal meters
numerical_sample_design.conditions: First seed1103, every gap/mask/block/tolerance and both regimes, all six pairs
numerical_sample_design.target_source: Bundled UCI daily-persistence forecasts at t+24; complete target reconstruction is possible on each selected day

scope.detailed_period_results: Reconstructed from archived daily scalar contributions, independently recomputed denominators/signs/normalizations/counts and corresponding aggregation/matched-selection tables: 31UCI meters only
scope.all_cohort_aggregates: Scenario and named-pair summaries independently reconcile to cohort summaries; matched count constraints checked for all cohorts
scope.direct_reconstruction: Timestamp/source-row eligibility checked for UCI only; UCI copy values hash-checked; BLEM values remain omitted
scope.numerical_endpoints: Independent SciPy linear programs, feasible primal witnesses and direct paired MSE on fixed UCI samples
scope.mask_checks: Every contiguous/scattered mask independently regenerated; all other masks checked for cardinality and consistency across information/bound settings. High-demand ranks additionally reconstructed on fully copy-covered UCI days, using four explicit original-source rounding corrections from the separate mask audit.
not_rerun: Every daily numerical bound from raw observations
Profile/donor reconstruction from raw training observations
BLEM target values and persistence-copy value hashes
Paid-query choices: this analysis is zero-query; separate daily recovery has its own verifier
BLEM daily scalar traces and method-specific period cases are deliberately omitted; --raw regeneration is needed for full34 scalar reconstruction

interval_trace_audit.scope: Independent stdlib reconstruction of pair/seed aggregates into meter, cohort and exact-versus-greedy tables; report JSON reconciled to CSVs. The 192 LP endpoint fixtures are rerun by importing the original helper, explicitly not an independent fixture implementation.
interval_trace_audit.limitations: No raw-trace re-execution, no retraining, no independent recovery-solver implementation, and no independent per-case certificate or query verification. Missing mixed target archive is permitted for supplement-only reconstruction. Separate editorial review examined closure, greedy selection and witness functions. Constructed uncertainty and dependent historical cases do not measure calibration, costs or production latency.
